# Let me verify what the current naturalday returns for various inputs
import datetime as dt
from freezegun import freeze_time

with freeze_time("2023-10-15 14:00"):
    import humanize
    
    # Current behavior
    print("naive datetime Oct 16:", humanize.naturalday(dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16)))
    print("plain date Oct 16:", humanize.naturalday(dt.date(2023, 10, 16)))
    
    tz = dt.timezone(dt.timedelta(hours=11))
    aware_dt = dt.datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=tz)
    print("tz-aware datetime Oct 16 +11:", humanize.naturalday(aware_dt))
    
    # Also check what _abs_timedelta does
    from humanize.time import _abs_timedelta
    delta = dt.date(2023, 10, 16) - dt.date(2023, 10, 15)
    print("delta days:", delta.days)
    print("5*365/12:", 5 * 365 / 12)
    print("delta >= threshold:", delta.days >= 5 * 365 / 12)
